summary: Actuate Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Martin H. Huber, MD, to its Board of Directors on May 1, 2026, filling a newly created seat expanding the board from seven to eight. Dr. Huber will serve as a Class III director until the 2027 annual meeting. He receives standard non-employee director compensation including an option for 30,000 shares and a $44,000 annual retainer, plus a separate consulting fee of $3,000 quarterly for R&D advisory. No terms disclosed. The appointment appears routine, as a director addition, not a forced departure. What to watch: whether Dr. Huber's expertise influences strategic direction.
